foundationBatch.doneWhen: Color roles, state colors, and component examples all resolve to Energy tokens.
Edenred/Ubuntu roles are visible in type specimens and real content examples.
Spacing, density, grid, and responsive examples are explicit and token-backed.
Elevation, overlay, z-index, and focus layering are shown in product surfaces.
Motion examples are animated or stateful and include reduced-motion behavior.
State precedence is documented and visible in examples.
Content examples show what changes in language and why.
Adoption and telemetry examples are tied to product decisions.
Symbols are domain-specific and do not replace functional icons.
Icons render as Material Symbols and map to accessible names and semantic roles.
Accessibility is shown as behavior, not only a checklist.
